# Barakode Technologies

> Barakode Technologies is a full-cycle software development agency engineering web, mobile, AI, and cloud products for startups and enterprises worldwide. Engineering Solutions. Delivering Results.

## About

Barakode Technologies (also called "Barakode") is a software development agency based in Pakistan, serving clients worldwide. The company offers full-stack development, cloud and DevOps, UI/UX design, and staff augmentation services.

## Core services

- **Full-Stack Development** — React, Next.js, Node.js, Express, REST APIs, enterprise applications. Starts from $3,599.
- **Cloud & DevOps** — AWS, GCP, Azure, CI/CD pipelines, infrastructure as code. Starts from $1,399.
- **UI/UX & Product Design** — research-driven design, Figma prototyping, design systems. Starts from $599.
- **Mobile App Development** — React Native, Flutter, iOS, Android, cross-platform apps.
- **AI / Machine Learning** — LLM integration, computer vision, recommendation engines.

## Pricing plans

- **Standard Plan** — $500 per project. 4-6 week delivery. Clear scope, focused requirements.
- **Premium Plan** — $1,000 per project. 4-12 week delivery. Full-cycle development with dedicated project manager.

## Key facts

- 98+ happy clients served
- 20M+ lines of production code shipped
- 98% on-time delivery rate
- Awards: Clutch Top Software Development Company 2024, GoodFirms Best Web & Mobile App Development Agency 2024, Awwwards Site of the Day, Deloitte Technology Fast 500, Forbes Top 10 Emerging Software Agencies USA 2023

## Featured projects

- **Gman Stitching Platform** (2023) — Full-stack tailoring management platform built with Node.js, React, Prisma, Docker, MySQL. Replaced a failing PHP/Laravel legacy system, achieving a 70% improvement in response time.
- **Beyut Libya — Real Estate Platform** (2025) — Real estate listing and management platform.
- **OpenInterview — Video Interview Platform** (2025) — Video interviewing platform for hiring teams.
